input.subject: Renter looking: 1BR Williamsburg, up to $4,200/mo, no fee
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

I have a great tenant looking to lease in Williamsburg for a Sept 1 move-in.

- True 1BR (or big alcove studio)
- Budget up to $4,200/mo, prefers no fee
- Laundry in building, dishwasher
- Near the L or G
- 700+ credit, guarantor available if needed

Send me listings or let me know if you have something coming available. Co-broke standard.

Sofia Marin
Compass
